claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Sony US26650VT as a flat-top, unprotected 26650 cell.
Steam Engine preserves Sony US26650VT 3500mAh 50A as a 3500mAh preset with a 50A runtime rating.
Sony's announcement for the 26650VT identifies a lithium-ion cell using a nickel/manganese mixture in the positive electrode.
The exact catalog entry Sony US26650VT has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2005-01 or earlier.
